questions.q: This time tomorrow I ___ on a beach.
questions.why: Процес у певний момент майбутнього (*This time tomorrow*) — Future Continuous: *I will be lying on a beach.*
*By 8 pm* — до моменту вже буде зроблено: Future Perfect *will have done*.

questions.q: Don't call at noon — we ___ (have) lunch.
questions.why: Опівдні ми будемо в процесі обіду — *will be having lunch*.

questions.q: By the time you arrive, they ___ (leave).
questions.why: *By the time you arrive* — вони вже підуть: *will have left*.

questions.q: In July she ___ here for ten years.
questions.why: Тривалість до моменту в майбутньому (*In July … for ten years*) — *will have been working*.

questions.q: ___ you ___ the car tonight? I need it.
questions.why: *Will you be using…?* — ввічливе питання про плани (не прохання напряму).

options: By the time she arrives, I will finish.
By the time she arrives, I will have finished.
By the time she will arrive, I will have finished.
By the time she arrives, I will be finish.
questions.why: Після *by the time* — Present Simple, у головній — Future Perfect.

questions.q: This time next week we ___ (travel) through Italy.
questions.why: *This time next week* — процес: *will be travelling*.

answer: By Friday I will have finished the project
questions.why: *By Friday* — до моменту в майбутньому: Future Perfect *will have finished*.

questions.q: By next year I ___ (save) enough money.
questions.why: *By next year* — *will have saved*.

questions.q: At 10 am tomorrow I ___ (sit) in a meeting.
questions.why: Процес у конкретний момент майбутнього (о 10-й) — *will be sitting*.

questions.q: By the time we get there, the film ___ (start).
questions.why: Фільм почнеться раніше — *will have started*.

questions.q: Next month I ___ (live) here for a year.
questions.why: Тривалість до моменту — *will have been living* / *will have lived*.

questions.q: ___ you be passing the post office? Could you post this?
questions.why: *Will you be passing…?* — ввічливо про плани.

questions.q: I'll call you at 8. — No, I ___ then.
questions.why: О восьмій я буду в дорозі — *will be driving*.
До 2030 знайдуть — *will have found*.

questions.q: When you arrive, I ___ dinner, so we can eat at once.
questions.why: Вечеря буде готова до вашого приходу — *will have cooked*.

answer: This time next week I will be lying on a beach
questions.why: Процес у момент майбутнього — *will be lying*.
questions.hint: Цієї пори наступного тижня я лежатиму на пляжі.

answer: They will have finished by six
questions.why: *by six* — Future Perfect: *will have finished*.

answer: Will you be using the car tonight
questions.why: *Will you be using…?* — ввічливе питання про плани.
О восьмій ми будемо в процесі вечері — *will be having dinner*.

questions.q: She ___ home by now. Let's call her.
questions.why: Припущення про вже завершене — *will have arrived*.
*By 2030* — Future Perfect: *will have built*.
